judgement.doubts: The generated/assisted line is close: the author steered at a 'meta-level' but by the paper's own account the LLM produced the constructions that are in the result and the author verified them, which is the definition of generated. The record's quotes come from a fetch-tool summary rather than a full read. Comellas table adoption supports correctness of the new records.

corrections.why: F1/F3: new record lower bounds for N(12,5) and N(16,5) move a quantity whose exact value stays open; the record's own competing_reading notes 'neither N(12,5) nor N(16,5) has a matching upper bound proof'. A new table entry is a bound, not a resolution or a settled case.
F14: a progress row carries no direction; nothing was settled.

other: basis_quote says 'the LLM produced the initial 132-vertex controller' and ChatGPT served as 'discovery engine' while 'the author checked the mathematical claims, code, certificates'; the summary states the human did not supply candidate components. The AI produced the construction and a human checked it, which is generated; steering and verification do not make it assisted.
